_comment: Alliance Recognition research tree for Last Z. 19 nodes, 356,770 total badges. Unlocked after first Alliance Duel event. Data sourced from lastzguides.com and lastzdata.com (May 2026).

days.name: Modded Vehicle Boost
days.description: Score points by spending vehicle modification resources. Save everything — Golden Wrenches, Blueprints, and Component Boxes — for this day only.
tips: Do NOT open wrenches, blueprints, or component boxes on any other day — all must be saved for Monday.
Golden Wrenches are the highest-value item: 5,000 base points each (18,400+ with max Alliance Recognition).
Orange Chip Chests are extremely valuable — approximately 1,000,000 points each.
Killing Creeps and Boomers scores here too — coordinate with your alliance.
Radar missions and resource gathering also count but are lower priority.

days.name: Shelter Upgrade
days.description: Score points through building upgrades, construction speed-ups, orange bounty missions, and refugee recruitment.
tips: Construction speed-ups score 107 points each — use all accumulated speed-ups today.
Orange Bounty missions award ~805,000 points for 5 completed. Save 20–40 Refresh Tickets to reroll for orange bounties.
Orange Refugees: 107,000 pts. Purple: 26,000 pts. Blue: 5,300 pts. Green: 0 pts — skip all green refugees.
Alliance Recognition research (Incentive — Development) also scores on this day — invest badges here if you haven't maxed it.
Target 2.2M+ points for full rewards; 6M is achievable with full resources.

days.name: Age of Science
days.description: Score points by spending research badges and using research speed-ups. This is the most important day for Alliance Recognition progress.
tips: Save ALL badges for Wednesday — spend none on other days. 20,000 badges ≈ 2M+ points.
Completing Alliance Recognition nodes here scores double — badges spent + Duel points from node bonuses.
Rush Premium Rewards → Event Expert → Super Rewards first on this day for compounding scoring.
Only S-rank (orange) Intercity Trade Trucks count — approximately 4 trucks = 1,200,000 points. Purple/blue trucks score nothing.
1-minute research speed-ups are efficient here — queue short research and chain speed-ups.

days.name: Hero Initiative
days.description: Score points by spending hero fragments, equipment materials, and power cores.
tips: Hero Fragments of any color (orange, purple, blue) all score — spend all accumulated fragments today.
Enhancement Alloys score — but ONLY use on orange-tier equipment. Never waste on purple or blue gear.
This is generally the easiest day to hit high scores with consistent daily hero investment.
Prime Recruitment Tickets and equipment upgrades also count here.

days.name: Holistic Growth
days.description: Score points by training troops and using training speed-ups. Save every speed-up from the entire week for today.
tips: Save every single training speed-up accumulated all week — spend none before Friday.
Lower-tier troops maximize points per speed-up minute — consider training T1/T2 if you have queued speed-ups.
Hold Radar tasks from earlier in the week and complete them today for bonus points.
Season 2 Overlord items also score here — use any that have accumulated.

days.name: Enemy Buster
days.description: Score points by killing enemy troops and completing combat objectives. Unique Valor Medal rewards — exchangeable for orange equipment in the Black Market.
tips: Killing enemy alliance troops scores the most points — coordinate attacks with your alliance.
Having your own troops killed in combat also scores.
Orange Wanted missions contribute — complete all available.
Valor Medal reward: 5,200 per full unlock (10,400 with max Alliance Recognition via One More!).
Valor Medals exchange for orange equipment in the Black Market — one of the best gear sources in the game.
